card.name: The verb owe and duty words
card.fires_on: The verb "owe" (and the word right after it, like "it" or "them") when someone is said to owe something morally. Also nouns of duty such as responsibility, obligations, duty of care.

modes.label: Owe in moral appeals
modes.description: The verb owe, or the pronoun after it, in a statement of what a group owes itself or others.
modes.example: Knowing this fact, we as Latinas,<< owe>> it to ourselves and to our herman

modes.label: Duty and obligation nouns
modes.description: Nouns naming a duty or responsibility that someone holds toward others.
modes.example: Muslim doctors and physicians were expected to have<< obligations>> towards their patients, regardless of their wealth

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with owe, duty and obligation words.
card.plain: It lights up when text says someone owes something or has a duty to others.
